meta.title: Loodly for business — orders, loyalty and delivery
meta.description: Online orders, a loyalty card with points, rewards, couriers and reports for ice cream shops, bakeries, cafés and pastry shops — connected to your receipts and invoicing system.

hero.title: Orders, points and delivery — one system for all your locations
hero.subtitle: For ice cream shops, bakeries, cafés and pastry shops — from a single location to a chain across several cities.
hero.subtitle_more: Customers order in the Loodly app and collect points with you on one card, and we connect Loodly to the system you use for receipts and invoices.
hero.visual_alt: Illustration: the brand console on a laptop, a tablet with orders at the location, a customer's phone with their card, and a courier on a scooter.

story.title: From your first sign-in to your first delivery
story.subtitle: Here's what getting started and an ordinary day with Loodly look like — the same for bakeries, cafés, ice cream shops and pastry shops.

setup.title: Before you open the doors
setup.subtitle: You set up your brand and locations in the brand console in your browser, and your menu in the Loodly Spot app.

counter.title: At the counter
counter.subtitle: Your team works in the Loodly Spot app — on a phone, a tablet or in the browser at the register.

beyond.title: Beyond the counter
beyond.subtitle: App orders and deliveries land in the same place as the rest of your work.

account.title: We set up your brand account
account.body: We create your brand on Loodly and email an invitation to your first admin. You set your own password and you're in the brand console.
account.alt: Animation: an invitation envelope drops into a laptop, a sign-in form appears and a green check mark confirms it.

brand.title: Show customers who you are
brand.body: Add your logo, a cover photo, a description in several languages and the cities you work in. That's how customers will see you in the Loodly app and on the website.
brand.alt: Animation: a banner, a logo, description lines and three city tags appear in the brand console, followed by a save confirmation.

spots.title: Add your locations
spots.body: Each location has its own address, opening hours, team, and pickup, delivery and payment settings. New locations start as drafts — you activate them when they're ready.
spots.alt: Animation: three locations appear on a city map, linked to the brand logo, and their markers turn green.

menu.title: Fill in your menu
menu.body: In the Loodly Spot app, add products with photos, prices and allergens — and decide how many points each one earns. When something sells out, your team marks it in one tap.
menu.alt: Animation: product cards appear on a tablet — coffee, a croissant, ice cream and cake — and one product is briefly switched off.

scan.title: Scan the customer's card
scan.body: The customer shows a QR code or barcode in the app. Scan it with the camera or a barcode scanner and you instantly see their points with your brand and any rewards ready to hand over.
scan.alt: Animation: a scanner reads the barcode on a customer's phone, then a green confirmation and a points coin appear.

points.title: Points for every purchase — sometimes double
points.body: Staff add points from ready-made templates, and app orders earn points automatically. Want to liven up the quieter hours? Set up a promotion such as double points on Thursdays from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. — at one location or all of them.
points.alt: Animation: a clock hand moves into the highlighted 10-to-2 window, a “times two” badge appears and coins drop onto the card in pairs.

rewards.title: Happy customers who come back
rewards.body: Customers swap points for your rewards: a coffee, a pastry, a scoop of ice cream or merch with your logo — in the app or right at the counter. Points collected with you can only be spent with you, at any of your locations.
rewards.alt: Animation: a mug with a logo pops out of a gift box, two customers smile and little hearts float up.

moreOrders.title: Orders even when customers aren't in the shop
moreOrders.body: Customers order in the Loodly app and on the website — from home, from work or on the go, for pickup or delivery. Your location's news, birthday points and referrals keep you on their mind between visits.
moreOrders.alt: Animation: orders fly to the shop from a house, an office and a park, and a stack of tickets grows on the counter.

onlineOrders.title: Online orders, straight to your tablet
onlineOrders.body: A new order shows up in the Loodly Spot app with a sound alert. You accept it, prepare it and mark it ready, and the customer sees every step.
onlineOrders.alt: Animation: an order flies from a customer's phone to the shop's tablet, a bell rings, the order is accepted and its status changes to ready.

couriers.title: Courier on the way, live on the map
couriers.body: Couriers using the Loodly Courier app apply to your location, and you choose who to accept and set what they earn per delivery. Assign the order and the customer follows it live.
couriers.alt: Animation: a courier rides from the shop to the customer's home, ending with a pin and a green check mark.

benefits.title: What Loodly gives you
benefits.subtitle: Everyday tools for you, your team and your customers.

loyalty.title: A loyalty program without paper
loyalty.body: Instead of stamp cards, one card on your customer's phone. You choose the rewards and their price in points — and customers get a reason to come back to you.

orders.title: Online orders from your menu
orders.body: Customers order from your menu for pickup or delivery and pay online or in person — however you set up each location.

locations.title: Many locations, one program
locations.body: All your locations in one console, even across cities. Points and rewards work at every one of them, while each location keeps its own hours, menu and team.

promotions.title: Promotions, birthdays and referrals
promotions.body: Double points on chosen days and hours, birthday points and a bonus for inviting a friend. You decide whether to give points — and how many.

couriers.title: Couriers and live tracking
couriers.body: Work with couriers you approve. Customers follow the delivery live on the map.

reports.title: Reports per location and brand-wide
reports.body: PDF reports on orders, points, deliveries and staff sign-ins for each location, plus order and points summaries for your whole brand.

roles.title: Your whole team, each in the right place
roles.subtitle: Everyone signs in with their own account and sees only what they need — at one location or several.

brandAdmin.title: Brand admin
brandAdmin.body: Sets up the brand, locations, rewards, promotions and team in the brand console. Sees brand-wide reports and can work at any location in the Loodly Spot app.

locationAdmin.title: Location admin
locationAdmin.body: Runs their locations in the Loodly Spot app: menu, opening hours, orders, couriers and employees. Sees reports for their locations.

employee.title: Employee
employee.body: Takes orders, scans customer cards, adds points from ready-made templates and hands out rewards.

roles.safety1: Employees add points only from set templates
roles.safety2: A cap on manually added points and an optional daily limit per person
roles.safety3: No one on your team can add points to their own account

rewards.title: Thank your regulars with rewards
rewards.body: A product from your menu or merch with your logo — you decide what goes into the catalog, what it costs in points and how many are available.
rewards.note: Below are examples with the Loodly logo — your catalog will carry yours.

integration.title: Works with what you already use
integration.body: You don't have to change how you issue receipts and invoices. As part of setup, we connect Loodly to the system you use every day for sales, receipts and invoices. We work out the scope with you — which is why we quote it individually.
integration.p1: Keep issuing receipts and invoices the way you do today
integration.p2: We agree on the integration scope with you before we quote
integration.p3: Tell us which system you use and we'll check the options
integration.node_system: Your sales, receipts and invoicing system
integration.diagram_alt: Diagram: your receipts and invoicing system connected to Loodly, and Loodly connected to the tablet at your location and your customer's phone.
integration.hardware_body: A phone or tablet with the Loodly Spot app is all you need — scan customer codes with the camera. You can also plug in a barcode scanner; we'll test yours with you during setup.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How long does it take to get started?
faq.a1: It mostly depends on the integration scope, the number of locations and the size of your menu. We agree on a start date with you and include it in the quote.
faq.q2: Do I need to change my register or invoicing software?
faq.a2: No. We connect Loodly to the system you already use for sales, receipts and invoices. Tell us what you use and we'll check the options and scope before quoting.
faq.a3: A phone or tablet with the Loodly Spot app is enough — you scan customer cards with the camera. At a register with a computer, you can run Loodly Spot in the browser with a barcode scanner plugged in. For codes shown on a phone screen, image-based (2D) scanners work best, since laser scanners often can't read screens — we'll test yours during setup.
faq.q4: Can customers spend my points somewhere else?
faq.a4: No. Points collected with your brand can only be spent on your rewards — at any of your locations. Customers have one card, but each brand's points are kept separately.
faq.q5: I have several locations, some in different cities. Will it work?
faq.a5: Yes. A brand can have many locations across different cities. Each location has its own hours, menu and team; points and rewards are shared across the brand, and promotions can run at all locations or selected ones.
faq.q6: Will it be my own app?
faq.a6: Your locations appear in the Loodly app and on the Loodly website — with your logo, description, menu and your own points program. Customers use one app for every location on Loodly, but the points they collect with you can only be spent with you.
faq.a7: Data processing is covered by our agreement and the Loodly privacy policy. Day to day, you see your brand's orders, points and reports. We're happy to go through the details when we prepare your quote.
faq.a8: Contract length and notice terms are agreed individually. Get in touch and we'll walk you through them.

pricing.spot_fallback: A small monthly fee for each location

pricing.inc2: The Loodly Spot app for your team
pricing.inc3: The brand console in your browser
